responsibility: Defines and manages the borrow checker’s NLL outlives constraint set, including storage of individual `R1: R2` constraints, creation of normal and reverse graph views, computation of region SCCs for inference, and insertion of conservative `'static` outlives constraints to recover from incompatible-universe cases before recomputing SCC structure.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is centered on the shared data structure for NLL outlives constraints and their graph/SCC views. It is not a top-level orchestration module like `type_check`, `region_infer`, or `polonius`, nor a diagnostics/reexport surface; its role is the constraint-set substrate those analyses consume.
